signatures.description: Implement a lease coordinator for a partitioned service where workers have bounded but changing clock skew, delayed messages, and crash-recovery from persisted state. Prevent stale holders from committing after lease transfer using fencing tokens while preserving availability under the stated quorum rules, and supply a deterministic event simulator that finds safety violations in adversarial schedules.
